links.comparator_used: No calibration (uncalibrated base classifier probabilities), across five classifiers on the MIMIC-IV external cohort
links.outcome: Demographic Calibration Gap Score (DCGS) across racial and gender subgroups, relative to the 0.05 clinical significance threshold
links.effect: DCGS exceeded the 0.05 threshold in 28 of 40 model-calibration combinations on the race axis. Neither global Platt scaling nor isotonic regression reliably brought DCGS below the threshold.
links.quote: Neither global Platt nor isotonic calibration reliably reduced DCGS below that threshold.

design_hint: recalibration (global and subgroup-targeted) with subgroup calibration auditing
